name: Cinder Ward
description: Wrap an ally in a burning barrier. Attackers touching it take fire damage and add Heat to the ward.

name: Kindled Guardian
description: A protected ally gains Heat when the ward absorbs punishment.

name: Heat Transfer
description: Transfer stored Heat from a ward to a fire-aligned caster, increasing the next fire effect.
effects: convert ward heat into spell power

name: Fire Funnel
description: Consume Heat and Rage to create a spiraling column of flame that damages and traps enemies.

name: Ember Thread
description: Thread fire through an ally without burning them, allowing spells to curve around protected targets.

name: Furnace Spell
description: A fire spell grows stronger as Heat accumulates, then vents the stored Heat when it resolves.

name: Furnace Rage
description: Taking damage while heated builds Rage. Rage amplifies fire attacks until discharged.

name: Ash Eruption
description: Discharge Rage in a burst of flame and ash around the warrior.

name: Veil Strike
description: A weapon attack emerges from shadow and deals bonus damage after movement through darkness.

name: Shadow Lunge
description: Leap between nearby shadows and strike an exposed target.

name: Umbra Ward
description: A dark barrier absorbs harm and lashes out at creatures that break through it.

name: Dark Reflection
description: The ward briefly creates a shadow double that redirects the next hostile effect.

name: Thunder Ward
description: A barrier stores lightning from incoming attacks and releases it against nearby enemies.

name: Chain Conduit
description: Stored lightning jumps between enemies whenever the protected ally is struck.

name: Frost Ward
description: A cold barrier slows attackers and builds Frostbite on repeated contact.

name: Glacial Lock
description: Targets carrying enough Frostbite become immobilized in ice.

name: Crimson Vow
description: Convert a portion of healing into stored Blood Power for later retaliation.

name: Blood Reprisal
description: Spend Blood Power to punish enemies that damaged an ally you healed.

name: Void Rift
description: Open a temporary tear that bends movement and spell paths around its edge.

name: Gravity Well
description: Collapse a Void Rift into a localized pull that drags enemies toward its center.

name: Guardian Spirit
description: Summon a spirit that intercepts one hostile attack and then empowers nearby healing.

name: Spirit Link
description: Link allies so a portion of one ally's recovery echoes through the group.

name: Iron Guard
description: Brace against an incoming blow and store part of the absorbed force.

name: Breaking Counter
description: Release stored force as a heavy counterattack that can stagger an attacker.

name: Cinder Form
description: Assume a primal fire form that leaves burning ground while moving.

name: Wildfire Roots
description: Roots erupt beneath enemies and ignite, combining restraint with burning terrain.

name: Dawn Ward
description: A radiant shield protects an ally and sears creatures carrying curses.

name: Radiant Reprisal
description: When Dawn Ward breaks, release a flash of cleansing light.

name: Bloodflame
description: Ignite Blood Power into unstable flame that grows stronger as health falls.

name: Hemorrhagic Burst
description: Detonate Bloodflame, consuming stored power and spreading burning wounds.
